clips.title: 彭博科技主编：Anthropic指控阿里大规模蒸馏，硅谷担忧配置被中国利用
title_lines: 彭博科技主编 Mike Shepherd
硅谷担忧配置被中国利用

subtitles.en: just a few weeks ago, that Anthropic itself was pointing the finger at Ali Baba, accusing it of a large scale campaign of distillation.
subtitles.zh: 就在几周前，Anthropic 指责阿里巴巴进行大规模蒸馏活动。

subtitles.en: Now, to be clear, this is a technique that is commonly accepted when it comes to AI, when you have a larger model used to build a smaller model, a larger frontier model whose data are extracted and results are extracted to produce something that's a little smaller, more focused and less advanced.
subtitles.zh: 澄清一下，这是AI领域常见的技术：用大模型来构建小模型，提取前沿模型的数据和结果，生成更小、更专注、不那么先进的模型。

subtitles.en: But the claim from Silicon Valley is that look, what's happening is that all of the physical investments that we're making and spending all these billions of dollars on are being instead used by Chinese competitors to build this rival generation.
subtitles.zh: 但硅谷声称，我们投入数十亿美元的所有实体投资，反而被中国竞争对手用来打造竞争性模型。

clips.title: 芯片股暴跌背后：AI配置信心动摇，中国低成本模型引发质疑
title_lines: 彭博科技主编 Mike Shepherd
AI配置信心动摇，中国低成本模型引发质疑

subtitles.en: This is why we saw this huge dip in chip stocks and this announcement came out. Is that just about this model or does that kind of compound on some of the concerns about this KAPS investment, especially it seems to me, when you look at what China can bring to the table, if they have the technology side here in the US, we focus so much on the energy aspect on building these data centers, on whether or not they can support them.
subtitles.zh: 这就是我们看到芯片股大跌的原因。这不仅仅关乎模型本身，还加剧了对KAPS投资的担忧。中国能带来什么？美国这边我们过于关注数据中心的能源问题。

subtitles.en: That seems a lot easier to do coming out of a top-down system like Beijing. Is that part of this concern as well? It certainly is and what you're seeing really is a return of that crisis of confidence and whether that AI trade will really sustain itself and can all of the investments that these companies are making in what could be trillions of dollars in infrastructure for data centers and chips and other materials will keep going and can they justify it.
subtitles.zh: 在像北京这样的自上而下体系中，这似乎容易得多。这也是担忧的一部分吗？确实如此，我们看到信心压力重现：AI交易能否持续？公司投入数万亿美元建设数据中心和芯片基础设施，能否证明其合理性？

clips.title: 中国开源模型冲击硅谷：低成本、可下载，美国AI商业模式受挑战
title_lines: 彭博科技主编 Mike Shepherd
中国开源模型冲击硅谷
低成本、可下载，美国AI商业模式受挑战

subtitles.en: It's harder to justify if they're cheaper and just as good models out there being offered and also models that can be downloaded. One of the differences that you see with OpenAI and Anthropic is their models are generally accessed through a website, through an API, at an enterprise level.
subtitles.zh: 如果存在更便宜、同样好且可下载的模型，就很难证明其合理性。OpenAI和Anthropic的模型通常通过网站或API在企业层面访问。

subtitles.en: With the Chinese approach, you've seen these startups use what's called open weight. That means you can just download it, modify it, adjust the parameters, and really tailor it to your needs. It's a lot harder to do that with some of the frontier models being developed by the US AI labs right now.
subtitles.zh: 中国初创公司采用开放权重的方式，你可以直接下载、修改、调整参数，真正定制化。而美国AI实验室的前沿模型很难做到这一点。

subtitles.en: That is again something that people are also questioning, the interoperability and functionality of what the US labs are producing. Then there's the cost that men have pointed to the fact that many of these Chinese companies are now offering their services at a much lower rate.
subtitles.zh: 人们也在质疑美国实验室产品的互操作性和功能性。此外，许多中国公司以低得多的价格提供服务。
